RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the December 10, 2004/Agrahayana 19, 1926 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests; Food Processing Industries;
Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
Illegal felling of sandalwood trees in
Kerala
*141. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that illegal felling
of sandalwood trees in Marayoor highrange
in Kerala has been rampant, leading to illicit
sandalwood oil distillation in Palakkad
district in Kerala;
(b) whether the forest officials of
Pallakkad district recently raided a few
distillation units using illegal stocks of
sandalwood; and
(c) whether any investigation is being
conducted on reported theft of sandalwood
from Marayoor highrange for clandestine
use by distillation units in Palakkad?
Pollution by thermal power plants
†*142. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) the total quantum of flyash produced
in each thermal power plant through the
waste products released from these plants
annually in the country;
(b) whether any measures have been taken
by Government for checking pollutants
releasing from the thermal power plants;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the total amount being spent
annually  by Government for the same?
Failure of PDS
*143. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR:
SHRI N. K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Public
Distribution System has failed to meet the
expectation of the masses;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government have received
a large number of complaints regarding
identification of beneficiaries, ration card
owners, etc.;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

44
(d) if so, the reasons therefor;
(e) whether Government would
consider to restore the universal rationing
system by replacing the existing targeted
Public Distribution System; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Physiotherapy Council
*144. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
form a Physiotherapy Council;
(b) if so, the details including the courses
incorporated under the purview of the
proposed Physiotherapy Council;
(c) whether the class I Physiotherapy
course recognised by the Ministry of Health
and Family Welfare OM No. 2867/61/MI/
MPT dated 30th December, 1964 and
record office of Army Medical Corps
instruction No. 91 dated 6th September,
1967 is also incorporated under the purview
of the proposed Physiotherapy Council;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof, and if not,
whether Army Medical Corps will be
consulted before finalising the form of the
Physiotherapy Council?
Cost of production of medicines
*145. SHRI M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
make it compulsory for pharmaceutical
companies to print the cost of production
of medicines on each and every medicine
pack;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether Government have also
discussed this issue with Finance Ministers
and Health Ministers of States recently;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) the steps taken by Government to
ensure availability of medicines at
reasonable prices to the general public?
Extra prices on  medicines
†*146. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that many
medicines manufacturing companies have
earned extra dividend in recent years by
charging extra price than the prescribed
price of many medicines;
(b) if so, the names of these companies;
(c) the names of medicines which have
been charged extra;
(d) whether Government have taken
action for recovering extra price charged by
these companies; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Functioning of Drugs Control
Organizations
*147. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA : Will the Minister of
HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that sub-standard
medicines in the country are being sold and
the Drug Controller has failed to curb their
sale;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

45
(c) whether Dr. Mashelkar Committee
Report has pointed out the inadequacy in
the Drugs Control Organizations (DCOs)
at the Central and State level and has
recommended the strengthening of DCOs;
and
(d) if so, what steps Government have
taken in this regard?
Suicide by farmers in Karnataka
*148. DR. VIJAY MALLYA:
SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of farmers who
committed suicide in Karnataka since 1998;
(b) the measures taken by Government
to prevent such deaths and the number of
families paid compensation and the amount
of compensation, so paid;
(c) the special incentives announced by
Hon'ble Prime Minister for the farmers of
Andhra Pradesh and when the same
incentives would be extended to farmers of
Karnataka; and if not, the reasons therefor;
and
(d) whether Government have
announced any fresh package for the
welfare of farmers?
Tiger reserves in the country
*149. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of tiger reserves in the
country;
(b) the funds spent on such reserves in
the country in 2003-04;
(c) the efforts being made to upgrade
such tiger reserves;
(d) whether any targets have been set
for 2004-05; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Poor infrastructure for environment
protection
*150. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether due to poor infrastructure,
the environment protection mechanism in
India suffers substantially which results in
a setback in the environment development;
(b) the details regarding Government's
efforts in the development of environment
protection infrastructure; and
(c) the details of allocation of funds
during the last five years for institutional
strengthening including training and staffing
of technical professionals?
Taking over of Super Bazar in Delhi
*151. SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
SHRI DIPANKAR
MUKHERJEE:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Kerala State Cooperative
Consumers' Federation Ltd. vide its
resolution dated 23rd October, 2003, had
decided to take over Super Bazar at New
Delhi;
(b) if so, whether the same is being
followed-up;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether National Consumer
Cooperative Federation (NCCF) has
offered to take over the Super Bazar vide

46
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
its letter dated 20th August, 2004 to Central
Registrar of Cooperative Societies;
(e) whether the same is being
considered; if not, the reasons therefor;
(f) whether the Central Registrar of
Cooperative Societies has ordered payment
of salary arrears to the employees; and
(g) if so, the action taken, so far, on the
issue?
Provision of cyber cafes and telecom
centres
†*152. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
provide cyber cafe and telecom centres at
all the railway stations shortly;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have made an
assessment of estimated expenditure for the
abovesaid arrangements; and
(d) if so, the details of the estimates for
the financial year 2004-05 as well as for
the next three years?
Shortage of wagon wheels
*153. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Indian Railways has
lately been saddled with over 20,000 wagons
bereft of wheels;
(b) if so, the main reasons for such
shortage of wheel sets and the present
annual requirement of railway for the same
and the total indigenous production and
capacity production of such wheels per
annum; and
(c) the steps taken or proposed to be
taken to meet the immediate requirements?
Rehabilitation of certain PSUs
*154. SHRI NILOTPAL BASU: Will
the Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken up
the question of rehabilitating certain public
sector units;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
People suffering from mental illness
†*155. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of persons suffering from
mental illness at present in the country,
State-wise;
(b) the number of persons deprived of
the medical facility, State-wise and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps Government propose to
take to provide adequate medical faculties
for mentally ill persons?
Opening of Ayurveda Institute at
Thiruvananthapuram
*156. SHRI N. K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of
HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any proposal for setting up
of an International Institute of Ayurveda in
Thiruvananthapuram is pending for
sanction;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government consider to
accord sanction for the project; and
(d) the reaction of Government thereto?

47
Sharing actionable intelligence in
tackling crimes
*157. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
had taken a decision to institutionalise the
sharing of actionable intelligence in crime-
prone States for tackling crimes;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
Government had taken a decision to deploy
additional railway police on the basis of
reports of crime and interaction with the
State Government police; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Absorption of retrenched steam
locomotive workers
*158. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether 5000 retrenched steam
locomotive workers will be absorbed by
the Railway Ministry after ten years;
(b) if so, the details of programme of
their absorption; and
(c) how will their services be utilised?
Infant mortality
*159. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI: Will
the Minister of  HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the infant mortality rate in Government
Hospitals;
(b) if so, the details thereof, hospital-
wise;
(c) the reasons of infant mortality; and
(d) what action is being taken to control
this?
Setting up of Medical Institutes on
IIT and IIM pattern
*160. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of  HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
propose to establish medical and other
health institutes of excellence on the pattern
of  IITs and IIMs; and
(b) if so, the details in this regard, with
revenue implications and the time-frame
for establishing such institutes in the
country?
NEW DELHI; YOGENDRA NARAIN,
The 4th December, 2004 Secretary-General.

RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the December 10, 2004/Agrahayana 19, 1926 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests; Food Processing Industries;
Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 155
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Cattle breeding farms
840. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of Central cattle
breeding farms which are now functional
in the country and their location, station-
wise;
(b) the present status of their
functioning;
(c) whether there is any proposal to
close down some of them including the one
at Chiplima in Orissa; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?
Sugarcane production
†841. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER SINGH
MAJITHA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
production of sugarcane has been declining
in the country for last few years;
(b) if so, the production of sugarcane in
2004-05 in comparison to the production
during the year 2000-01;
(c) whether it is also a fact that per
hectare production of sugarcane has
decreased during above years;
(d) if so, year-wise production rate of
sugarcane during above two years; and
(e) the reasons for low level of total
production of sugarcane?
Study report on suicide by farmers
†842. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER SINGH
MAJITHA:
 Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn towards the study report
published by Dr. V. Ratna and Dr. S. Glao
of "Centre for Economic and Social Study"
under the title "Farmers' Suicides: Looking
Beyond the Debt Trap";
(b) if so, whether this report reveals the
detailed information about the causes forcing
farmers to commit suicide; and

187
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
reaction of Government thereto?
Assessment on yield of Bt. cotton
843. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
undertaken any assessment on the yield of
Bt. Cotton in India, as there has been a lot
of controversy over the reports of the
independent surveys on the performance
of the Bt. Cotton; and
(b) if so, the details of assessment made
by Government in the matter?
Spraying of coca cola on crops as
pesticides
†844. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that farmers in
certain districts in Andhra Pradesh are
spraying coca-cola cold drink as a pesticide
for the protection of their crops;
(b) if so, the facts in this regard; and
(c) whether it is also a fact that the crops
are being protected by the above mentioned
spraying method?
Sreamlining NAIS
845. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of provisions of the Crop
Insurance Scheme in India and various
situations and conditions under which
farmers could become beneficiaries of this
scheme;
(b) whether farmers in various States
are opposing this scheme in view of its
failure to protect their interests;
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
remedial measures taken, so far, and
measures proposed to be implemented to
streamline the scheme;
(d) whether Government are seriously
contemplating to amend the Act of Crop
Insurance Policy in the best interest of the
farmers;
(e) if so, by when; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
Supply of spurious Bt. cotton seeds
846. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
a Multinational Private Company Mahyco
had been supplying inferior quality of Bt.
cotton seeds in Andhra Pradesh leading to
total crop loss;
(b) if so, the details thereof with regards
to Andhra Pradesh and all other States
where such inferior quality of B.T. cotton
seeds are supplied by Mahyco and other
Multinational companies;
(c) the details of action taken so far,
against these companies supplying Bt.
cotton seeds in India; and
(d) the details of action taken so far, for
compensating such loss of the farmers of
Andhra Pradesh and other States?

188
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Shortage of fodder for milch cattle
†847. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is
shortage of green and dry fodder for milch
cattle available in the country;
(b) if so, the average annual production
of green and dry fodder in the country;
(c) the number of milch cattle for which
this fodder production is sufficient in view
of requirements for a healthy milch cattle;
(d) whether it is a fact that this quantity
of fodder is insufficient owing to the
excessive number of milch cattle in the
country; and
(e) if so, the additional quantity of fodder
required in the country and what is the
expected number of milch cattle in the
country?
Improving cattle fairs
848. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been a demand to
develop and modernise the traditional
weekly cattle fairs all over the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the funds sanctioned for this purpose
during 2003-04;
(d) the funds utilised, so far; and
(e) the steps proposed to be taken to
improve such fairs, in order to assist
farmers?
Horticulture mission
849. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have plans to
unveil Rs. 15,000 crores horticulture mission
to transform the country's wastelands into
valuable wealth-creating assets; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Allocations to animal husbandry and
dairying
†850. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
propose to allocate more money for animal
husbandry and dairying;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the quantum of amount likely to be
allocated for the same?
Cotton under Crop Insurance Scheme
†851. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the crops covered
under the Crop Insurance Scheme;
(b) whether it is a fact that main crop
like cotton has not been covered under Crop
Insurance Scheme; and
(c) the details of the incentives to be
given for production of cotton in the
country and specially in Madhya Pradesh
and Chhattisgarh?

189
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Project on Kamlia insect in Madhya
Pradesh
†852. SHRI LAXMINARAYAN
SHARMA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether any proposal for the control
of 'Kamlia' insect in certain districts of
Madhya Pradesh has been pending before
the Central Government;
(b) if so, the action being taken on the
said proposal; and
(c) by when the said proposal is likely
to be approved and the budget is sanctioned
for the same?
Testing laboratories
853. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of input testing
laboratories for pesticides, fertilizers,
micronutrients working at present;
(b) the details of their locations;
(c) whether their number is sufficient to
meet the requirements of the farmers; and
(d) if not, whether Government would
allow establishment of more such
laboratories in private sector?
Special studies by ICAR
854. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether an additional fund has been
provided to ICAR for conducting studies
on specific issues in problem areas;
(b) if so, the crops and subjects identified
for such special studies; and
(c) whether the mandate is to get the
time bound result?
Closing or shifting of Research
Institutes or Central Farms in Orissa
855. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of Central Farms and
Research Institutes in Orissa under the
agriculture sector either closed or shifted
out of the State;
(b) the reasons thereof;
(c) the number of persons who have
been rendered jobless thereby; and
(d) the details of infrastructure created
for these farms and institutes and whether
these are being utilized at present?
Development of floriculture in H.P.
856. SHRI ANAND SHARMA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have examined
the advantages of various agro climatic
zones in Himachal Pradesh for the
development of the floriculture and the
required infrastructure; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Mango diseases
†857. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that half of the
mango fruit production in the country is
wasted due to disease which destroys the
flowing in the mango trees;
(b) if so, whether Government have
made any research to save the mango fruit
entirely;
(c) if so, the details thereof;

190
(d) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(e) whether Government plan to spray
pesticides with the help of helicopters in
mango producing areas?
Seeds from Government stores
858. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government would educate
the farmers through mass media to buy
seeds only from Government retail stores;
(b) if so, whether Government would
consider insuring the crop if the seeds are
bought from the Government retails stores;
and
(c) if so, the details of compensation to
be given to farmers in case of failure of yield?
Compensation for agricultural loss
due to flood and drought in Kerala
859. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
 Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Chief Minister and other
Ministers of Kerala have submitted
representations for flood and drought relief
on various occasions seeking compensation
for agriculture loss;
(b) if so, the details thereof including relief
sought, relief recommended by committees
visited and granted during the last three years,
year-wise, category-wise; and
(c) the details of loss of human life and
farmers committing suicide due to natural
calamity and financial difficulty, due to loss
in agriculture and inability to pay back loan
to financial institutions, as submitted by
competent authority of Kerala during that
period, category-wise?
Profits of CWC and FCI
860. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Central Warehousing
Corporation (CWC) and Food Corporation
of India (FCI) are earning profits recently;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) the storage capacity of each of these
corporations alongwith the percentage
capacity utilization during the last three
years, separately; and
(e) the efforts made by Government to
increase the storage capacity particularly
in States like Tamil Nadu where
procurement is high and also to help the
corporation earn profit?
Fertilizers availability during Kharif
861. SHRI NILOTPAL BASU: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
availability of complex fertilizers has
affected the cultivation during the Kharif
season; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Farmers emigrating from A.P.
862. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether hundreds of debt-ridden
farmers in Andhra Pradesh  and Karnataka had
committed suicide during the last seven months;
(b) whether many distressed farmers
from Andhra Pradesh are attempting to
emigrate to Uganda and Kenya where they
have been offered arable land on lease to
grow cotton, sugarcane, tobacco and millets;
(c) whether Government are aware that
land-related issues have become hyper-
sensitive in Kenya/thereby even endangering
the lives of alien farming communities; and

191
(d) how Government propose to
mitigate the sufferings of emigrated
farmers?
Review of SCAP
863. SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have reviewed
the Special Agricultural Credit Plan
(SCAP);
(b) whether it has benefited the small
and marginal farmers; and
(c) if so, the details about the Plan and
Procedure being taken in Maharashtra?
Market-networks for agro-products
864. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to set
up a unified market-network for agro-
products and produces all over the country;
(b) whether such marketing facilities are
also likely to be extended to the rural areas
of Uttaranchal; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Tissue culture in Gujarat
865. SHRI LEKHRAJ BACHANI: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the Centrally
Sponsored Scheme for promotion of tissue
culture in the country;
(b) whether any such scheme has been
promoted in Gujarat during the last three
years;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the funds allocated for the purpose?
Coconut cultivation in Gujarat
866. SHRI LEKHRAJ BACHANI: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the coconut cultivation has
increased in Gujarat;
(b) if so, the details of production
recorded during each of the last three years;
district-wise; and
(c) the steps taken/proposed to be taken
to increase the domestic use of coconut
and coconut products and to set up coconut
based industries?
Suicide by farmers
†867. SHRI AJAY SINGH
CHAUTALA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of farmers who
committed suicide in Andhra Pradesh,
Maharashtra, Punjab, Karnataka, Tamil
Nadu, Himachal Pradesh etc. during the last
six months;
(b) the amount of agricultural loan to be
paid by these farmers and the amount of
economic need in respect of each of them;
(c) the reasons of negligence committed
by the State Governments towards these
farmers and the reasons of indifferent
attitude on the part of the Central
Government; and
(d) the action being taken by
Government to stop the incidents of suicide
by the farmers in future?
